messages:
maria: Heads-up — product wants client-side opt-in for experiment routing. Can we add an SDK hook and an x-redwood header so mobile can opt into variant assignment?
kevin: Clarify: do you mean client picks the variant and we respect it, or client suggests and server still enforces the rollout rules?
sara: We should support both. Suggest a small header surface: `x-redwood-variant: hint:v2` or `force:v2` and `x-redwood-optin: 1` to indicate explicit opt-in. Need telemetry for which path was used.
pranav: Strong 👍 on telemetry. Big concern: forced variants could bypass canary guards and inflate quota/cost. Server must validate against the rollout policy and token permissions.
kevin: Proposal: header semantics: `force:` only accepted if token has dev/force flag; `hint:` is advisory — server will still run deterministic sampling unless hint increases probability within policy bounds. Also add `x-redwood-variant-sticky-ms: 86400000` to express desired stickiness.
rollout-bot: rollout check: canary_v2 -> target: 5% global, guard: p95 latency < 200ms, allow_force: false, allow_hint: true.
maria: Perfect. For SDK, expose `setExperiment(name, {variant, mode:'hint'|'force', stickyMs})` and emit an `experiment_assign` telemetry event with trace id and assignment_reason (server_hash|client_hint|forced).
sara: Also recommend adding `x-redwood-trace` header to carry client tracing id so routing decisions can be correlated in dashboard. Example curl: ```http
POST /v1/generate HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.com
Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN
x-redwood-variant: hint:v2
x-redwood-optin: 1
x-redwood-trace: 01abcdeffedcba
Content-Type: application/json
```
kevin: Implementation notes: server parse order `force > hint > none`. If `force` arrives but token lacks permission -> respond 403 with structured reason `variant_forced_not_allowed`. If `hint` arrives treat it as delta to deterministic routing but still respect rollout caps. Log `route_reason` (`forced`, `client_hint`, `server_hash`, `fallback`).
pranav: Dashboard hooks: expose metrics per-rollout: `variant_assignment_rate`, `variant_optin_rate`, `variant_latency_p50/p95`, `variant_error_rate`. For telemetry volume control, sample detailed traces for 10% of opt-in events initially.
sara: UX change: rollout page should show a client-opt-in toggle, a warning for forceable variants (who can force), and a sample SDK snippet. Also show recent `route_reason` distribution.
kevin: Edge-case: what if client sends stickyMs longer than rollout TTL? Server should cap at rollout max_sticky_ms and record `sticky_capped=true` in logs. Also be careful with quota calculation if many clients force v2; add a guard to reject force when projected capacity would exceed reserved pool.
maria: OK, action items: update SDK API + docs (sara), server header parsing + guard checks + tests (kevin/pranav), UX updates for rollouts console (maria). I'll create the feature ticket.
kevin: I'll open a draft PR for server + SDK today. Will include migration notes and a linter in SDK to warn when `force` is used with prod tokens.
sara: Can we add a tiny E2E that simulates hint->server_hash fallthrough so we don't regress?
pranav: Also add unit tests for quota calc when forced assignments are accepted.
maria: Thanks team :thumbsup:
